_doc: Revert-verify for ems__Bug 1fdfd7fb (ExoSync body merge kept a section TWICE when its heading was renamed differently on both sides), subject = StructuredMerger.ts, guard "Divergent-rename guard" in mergeBody. Axes H* in packages/core/tests/unit/services/sync/StructuredMerger.heading-rename.test.ts. H3 is a regression control no mutant locks: the guard takes no part in a one-sided rename. H7 and H11 are the named prices (an unrelated delete-and-add on both sides; the SAME rename on both sides plus an addition on each side) and flip together with the fix. M6 (additions condition weakened to "either side added") is locked by H12-H15: a convergent rename next to a one-sided addition and a blank preamble must merge under ANY design. Hence the separate ems__Bug 96a86732 (rename on one side vs delete on the other resurrects the section) cannot be fixed by the plain M6 shape — its guard must also discount convergent additions and blank preambles, or these axes go red. No axis here asserts that resurrection either way: it belongs to that ticket. Incidental overlap, named: a rename-vs-delete where the DELETING side also added a section already conflicts through this guard (the reason does not claim a rename). Run: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this spec> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/services/sync/StructuredMerger.ts

M1_guard_never_fires._note: The pre-fix behaviour. H7 and H11 redden too, as expected: they are the named prices of the guard.

M3a_local_convergent_addition_counts._note: A heading added on BOTH sides (the same rename) must not count as a local-only addition.

M3b_remote_convergent_addition_counts._note: Mirror of M3a on the remote side.

M6_either_side_added._note: The plain shape of a rename-vs-delete guard (ems__Bug 96a86732): it would quarantine merges that must stay merges.

M7_reason_swaps_sides._note: The reason reaches the user as `warn: quarantined <path>: <reason>` in `exosync sync` and in the plugin's warning log; naming the sides the wrong way round sends them to the wrong version.

M8_exactly_one_local_addition._note: H9 is the only axis where one side adds TWO keys (a new section next to the renamed one).
